text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: GPU hotpath saturation detected in us-west-2. 99th latency spike + sustained queue growth. Start thread 2199990000
lynn_oncall: seeing heavy queue growth on hotpath, 10x steady-state. 429s rising to ~18% for tier=standard. paging sam.
sam_sre: on it. can you paste the latest qlen and pool sizes?
lynn_oncall: qlen per shard: [shard-0: 980, shard-1: 1120, shard-2: 860]; hotpool size reported=12 GPUs, autoscaler attempted scale to 24 but stuck at locking step. logs show 'scale-lock timeout' on orchestrator.
maria_eng: autoscaler logs -> "failed to acquire cluster-scaling-lock after 30s" repeatedly. There's a backlog in the token bucket admission checks too, looks like admission path became a hot CPU path.
elaine_prod: CX reporting partial outages for two mid-market customers (org: Acme & NovaApps). CS flagged increased 429s and several support pages.
customersuccess-john: Acme seeing failed job spikes starting ~09:12, they're in production. Need ETA for mitigation.
sam_sre: immediate mitigation plan: (1) open manual scale override to add +8 GPUs to hotpool, (2) reduce standard tier per-tenant rate by 30% to throttle heavy tenants, (3) temporarily disable prefix caching for experimental model variant to reduce KV pressure. doing 1 now.
deploy-bot: deploy request accepted by ops. Manual scale override queued: add 8 gpus -> executing.
lynn_oncall: while scaling, we keep seeing token bucket bursts allow big tenants to refill. suspect per-tenant token bucket capacity is too large for current pool size. need to tune tokenbucket capacities.
maria_eng: agreed. current per-tenant config (snippet):
```
rate_limit:
  - tier: standard
    refill_rate_per_sec: 100
    burst_capacity: 1000
  - tier: premium
    refill_rate_per_sec: 500
    burst_capacity: 5000
```
We should lower burst_capacity for standard to 300 and refill to 75 temporarily.
sam_sre: applying temporary RBAC change to admission controller to enforce new caps. doing safe change: standard burst 300, refill 75. patching now.
elaine_prod: can we set exception for premium support customers (NovaApps) so they don't get throttled? they'd be impacted.
sam_sre: yes, mark premium exceptions for NovaApps and Acme only if needed. but priority is overall stability; we'll monitor.
lynn_oncall: scale override completed, +8 GPUs online, hotpool=20. queue depth dropped ~35% within 90s. 429s dropped from 18% to 9% overall. still high for some shards.
maria_eng: good, but autoscaler still failing due to lock contention when trying to reconcile desired pools. opened a ticket to disable autoscaler reconciliation until we stabilize.
sam_sre: manual autoscaler pause applied. also adjusted tokenbucket config in runtime via feature-flag. new config applied.
lynn_oncall: monitoring: overall p50/p95 stable, p99 still elevated at ~1.8s for hotpath. number of queued requests now ~400 across shards.
elaine_prod: Acme is reporting immediate improvement, but says some long requests still error. Customer impact: partial degraded throughput, retries recommended. CS to send templated status update.
customersuccess-john: sending status now: "We are mitigating an ongoing capacity issue; partial service degradation affecting high throughput endpoints. Teams are actively scaling and tuning rate-limits."
maria_eng: also found admission slow-path caused by expensive redis lua script during token checkout. adding a fallback path to use approximate token checks (local token caches) for a short window. patch ready to roll.
sam_sre: patch looks safe, but requires rolling restart of 3 admission nodes. low-risk window requested. propose rolling restart across shards to avoid full outage.
lynn_oncall: schedule immediate rolling restart. restarting node adm-1 -> adm-1 back up, checks green. restart adm-2 -> adm-2 back up, minor spike in latencies but no errors. adm-3 restart queued.
deploy-bot: adm-3 restart completed. approximate token cache fallback active. admission latency reduced ~60%. queues decreasing.
maria_eng: note: during fallback we saw slight overcommit for premium tier for ~2m; reverted exceptions for NovaApps temporarily to protect pool. informed CS.
elaine_prod: NovaApps ok with temporary secondary throttling, appreciate the heads up.
sam_sre: next step: validate autoscaler lock root cause. early hypothesis: db transaction timeouts during leader election caused scale-lock to not be released. escalated to eng-infra.
lynn_oncall: for immediate mitigation we've: manual scale +8 GPUs, paused autoscaler, tightened standard tokenbucket, enabled approximate admission fallback, restarted admission nodes. metrics show 429s dropped to 3% overall, hotpath p99 down to ~1.1s.
customersuccess-john: sending customer follow-up advising retry/backoff and noting full remediation plan.
maria_eng: scheduled follow-up fix for autoscaler leader election next week. we'll also add alerting for scale-lock latency.
sam_sre: preparing handoff docs for night oncall. summary: cause=pool exhaustion + autoscaler lock race + oversized per-tenant burst capacity. mitigation=manual scale, tokenbucket tuning, admission fallback, autoscaler pause, restarts.
lynn_oncall: handoff to night oncall @sam_sre at 2200020000. Sam will own monitoring and rollback plan.
sam_sre: oncall ack. leaving runbook notes: if qlen rises >800 per shard -> revert tokenbucket to more aggressive caps and enact short maintenance window to drain. if autoscaler unlocks, re-enable with leader-election-timeout=60s.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied, customer impact reduced. Severity: sev2 -> monitoring. Next update scheduled in 30m. :white_check_mark:
